mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Career Development Plan' table (transferable skills row) and 'Career perspectives and employability' section
mappings.mapping_description: The concept explicitly addresses increased research and transferable skills leading to improved employability. The Career Development Plan enumerates transferable skills (research integrity; open science and FAIR practice; generative-AI literacy; grant writing; IP and exploitation; project management; science communication), and the 'Career perspectives and employability' section describes the fellowship completing the fellow's progression from plant physiologist/agronomist to an independent Agricultural Data Scientist, addressing the remaining competence gap in predictive modelling and validation.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome (For supported postdoctoral fellows) — HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge' and 'Non-academic placement' sections; project_summary.json — instrument_type/host/partner fields
mappings.mapping_description: The concept describes new mind-sets and approaches forged through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience: international mobility (Bulgaria-to-Hungary recruitment at ATK), inter-sectoral exposure through the AgroVIR non-academic placement and Krumatic software partner, and interdisciplinary integration combining plant physiology/agronomy with agricultural data science and Earth observation via the deliberately complementary two-way transfer of knowledge.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome (For supported postdoctoral fellows) — HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Networking, communication and public engagement' section
mappings.mapping_description: The concept explicitly addresses enhanced networking and communication with scientific peers and the general public: at least two peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, MATE/HUN-REN/ELTE seminars, practitioner-oriented demonstrations, an AgroVIR evaluation session, and public engagement including one public field demonstration with farmers and one public-facing article per year.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Alignment of working conditions with the European Charter for Researchers' section
mappings.mapping_description: The concept explicitly addresses alignment of working conditions with the European Charter for Researchers, evidenced at instrument level by the Career Development Plan (D1.3) and the documented supervision and training arrangements. No unverified HRS4R/HR Excellence award is claimed for the host, which is a compliant, conservative framing.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge' and 'Supervision cadence and governance' sections
mappings.mapping_description: The concept describes enhanced quality and sustainability of research training and supervision through a structured supervision cadence (weekly one-to-one meetings, co-supervisor technical sessions, quarterly CDP reviews), a Project Steering Group with defined decision rights and go/no-go milestone verdicts, and a complementary two-way transfer of knowledge between host and partners.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Host capacity, attractiveness and visibility' section
mappings.mapping_description: The concept addresses increased global attractiveness, visibility and reputation of the participating organisations, evidencing ATK's institutional readiness (prior MSCA Individual Fellowship LANDRACES; current Horizon Europe participation in COUSIN, AI4SoilHealth, TUdi) and describing the roles of ELTE, MATE, Krumatic, AgroVIR and the post-MSCA MVCRI replication route as reputation-building assets.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge' section; strategic_positioning.md — 'The project logic in one chain'
mappings.mapping_description: The concept describes stronger R&I capacity, output and better transfer of knowledge among participating organisations via the explicitly complementary two-way transfer of knowledge (the fellow contributes agronomy/plant physiology/DrR; the host and partners provide advanced data science, uncertainty analysis, hyperspectral/UAV/EO integration and research-to-software translation), plus targeted joint publications and the DrR web MVP as durable capacity outputs.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Teaching and education' section (including 2026-08-28 supersession note)
mappings.mapping_description: The concept addresses feedback of research results into teaching and education. Because HUN-REN ATK is a research organisation rather than a university, the concept explicitly routes teaching outside the host via short guest lectures, seminars and practical sessions at MATE and, where possible, the Agricultural University of Plovdiv, linking plant-stress physiology with UAV/EO monitoring and agricultural data science. The supersession note explicitly maps EO-08 to this guest-session mechanism.
